variant.briefing:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [Location]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [Objects]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.

For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering  [ScripAmount] MG Scrip to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
